notes: No mobile apps exist (no Swift or Kotlin; crates/ffi is a skeleton). The shipped surfaces today are the core crates, the Tauri desktop app (built and tested on Linux in CI; macOS and Windows only compile-checked for platform-auth), the `lockdown` CLI, the self-host server, a web vault the server serves (the same core on wasm32-wasip1 in a worker, doc 17), and an MV3 browser extension for Chromium and Firefox that works through the running desktop app (doc 16; Linux and macOS only until the identity crate has a Windows named-pipe transport; only Chromium is exercised in tests). The CLI still carries its own copy of several flows. policy, approval, bridge-host and ffi are skeletons. The code is licensed Apache-2.0 (D120). Lockdown's clients and server speak TLS 1.3 with the hybrid X25519MLKEM768 group first (crates/tls, doc 20); plain HTTP is refused away from loopback. Rows judged `done` are done for today's surfaces only; each still needs its mobile half, and the web vault refuses some features in words for now (doc 17 §10). OS-level integration and native mobile are deferred (D122): those rows carry `deferred`.

non_v1_built.note: Partly built: the `lockdown` binary (bins/cli/src/main.rs) does init, add/edit/list/show logins, account register/login, sync, kit, device list/revoke, attach/fetch, audit, checkpoint, code and match, with end-to-end tests (bins/cli/tests/end_to_end.rs:42). No JSON output, no biometric unlock through the desktop app, no secret references.

Largely built: "This device only" on first run makes a vault and kit with no account, and an account can be added later from Status (apps/desktop/src/features/unlock/first-run.tsx:122); `lockdown init` works without a server.

Built: every version shows when, by which device and which fields changed; an earlier version shows masked and Restore saves it as the newest (15-organization). Revealing an old version's secret is not built.
Detector only: crates/vault/src/crown_jewel.rs:112 looks_like_seed_phrase (test at :173); not wired to any paste or field.
